name: guardian_tool_allowlist
description: The read-oriented tools the agent may use and is offered. A command that is neither on this list nor in guardian_policy is denied.
data: {"_comment": "The read-oriented tools the agent may use. This list decides which tools are offered to the model, and its order is the priority when the tool definitions must fit a small token budget: Guardian's own tools first, then the Cortex platform reads for the issue, its case and its assets, then XQL and posture context, then reputation integrations, then the XSOAR-edition tools that remain for tenants that have them. Commands that are not installed on your tenant are dropped automatically.
